title: Before spawning work, a standing session searches for an existing build of it
why:
[18:18 CST Nov 15, triage] Owner words (relayed, verbatim as the consultant relayed them, typos kept): "im 10000% sure a pr already exists that rors that. u need to (abd all standing sessions frankly)) eed to first see if what they dpawn hasnt already been built somewhere before just starting it again". Context: the consultant had said it would queue a step for CI runs whose base is older than a revert on main. Consultant's reading: a standing rule for every standing session: search open and closed PRs, branches and main for an existing build before spawning. Guard or check: unknown; what check could prove it is open. Ruling own-search-before-spawn. (source: consultant 18:19 CST via the coordinator, relayed by triage; not owner-typed here)

[18:21 CST Nov 15, triage] Runner 11's report (its 18:21 message, relayed by the coordinator): a spawn-time search of PRs, branches and main named in the brief would have stopped starting degen #741 before searching; the search found nothing built, so #741 stands; no step exists that it knows of. The owner's 18:18 rule went out to runners 10, 11, 12 and g1 as a relayed word. (source: coordinator 18:22 CST, relayed by triage; unverified by triage)
